facts.business: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited is an integrated provider of EV charging solutions (AC and DC chargers for residential, public, commercial, fleet, and heavy-duty applications) and Critical Power solutions (telecom power systems, lithium-ion battery systems, and energy storage) for domestic and international markets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Focus on technology innovation, operational excellence, manufacturing scale-up, export expansion, customer-centric solutions while strengthening operational efficiencies, improving profitability, and creating sustainable long-term value.

key_risks: Near-term profitability impacted by market conditions and investments towards international operations
Supply chain dynamics and execution-related risks
Evolving market conditions and regulatory changes
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include purchases from EESPL (Rs 588.51 lakh), HTL (Rs 42.73 lakh), Innovative Roof (Rs 11.54 lakh); fixed asset purchases from EESPL (Rs 440.13 lakh); technology transfer from EESPL (Rs 820 lakh); services from HTL (Rs 42.91 lakh), EESPL (Rs 370.72 lakh in FY25), MK Knowledge LLP (Rs 40 lakh); sitting fees and commission to directors; HFCL and HTL are entities under control of KMPs/relatives.
